prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details - INV-90044
prose.body:
Hi Rafael,

I’m writing to you directly to expedite the settlement for invoice INV-90044. Due to a recent restructuring of our vendor payment gateway, our designated NEAR wallet address has been updated. Please disregard the previous details sent with the initial request.

To ensure the funds clear on time for this month’s reconciliation cycle, please direct the payment of 6898.80 USDC to the following new account:

rowanelgal51.testnet

This change is effective immediately. We have updated our internal ledger to reflect this, but your studio’s records need to be aligned to avoid a manual review delay on our end. Given the tight turnaround this week, your prompt attention to this would be greatly appreciated.

If you could confirm once the transfer has been initiated, that would be perfect. I have attached the updated remittance advice for your reference. Let me know if you encounter any issues with the new destination address.

Best regards,

Maya Tanaka
Accounts Payable Specialist
Rowan Legal
rowan-legal.example
